judgments.quote: At the 8-round maximum with lot 0 unresolved and no other lots auctioned, closing ends the game and calculates final scores.
judgments.reason: The model explicitly recognized and acted on the rule that reaching the round horizon allows closing the game and settling even with unresolved/unauctioned lots.
The model did not claim catalog purchases receive the auction commission; it explicitly noted catalog items are not auction wins and made no linkage of the +3 commission to buys.
